command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$node='HQ_PROC_PC01'; `$cmds=@('ping 10.3.30.1','ping 10.3.30.1 -c 5','trace 10.3.30.1','traceroute 10.3.30.1','show ip','ipconfig','display ip interface brief'); foreach(`$c in `$cmds){`$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$node+'/command?cmd='+`$e; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$o -notmatch 'not found'){Write-Output ('CMD='+`$c); Write-Output `$o}}"
